# Gradebook

## Summary
Learners × assignments (+ quizzes) matrix over resolved rows: letter cells, Grade buttons for the pile, overdue dashes, points-weighted overall, sortable.

## Usage
`<Gradebook @enrollments @assignments @submissions @quizzes @attempts @gradeScale @onGradeSubmission />`

## Non-goals
Fetches nothing; the workspace owns the queries.
